claim: Try it with sample data opens two isolated sample quotes.
sandbox: fresh browser; click the landing action; assert /demo, banner, samples, and demo IndexedDB namespace

claim: Quote data stays on this device during normal use.
where: landing facts, data screen, privacy page
sandbox: fresh /demo browser flow; record every request while opening a sample quote and assert same-origin only

claim: Exports the quote log as JSON.
sandbox: fresh /demo; download JSON and assert exactly two seeded quotes

claim: Exports the quote log as CSV.
sandbox: fresh /demo; download CSV and assert one header plus two quote rows

claim: Each saved quote version has a SHA-256 fingerprint.
sandbox: fresh /demo; open a seeded quote and assert its exposed full 64-character fingerprint

claim: A named review is shown before a quote is send-ready.
sandbox: fresh /demo; open the send-ready Website launch sample and assert its named review and send-ready status

claim: A client link carries the reviewed quote in its URL fragment.
sandbox: fresh /demo; prepare the Website launch link and assert its client payload is in the URL fragment

claim: Exports a portable JSON client decision receipt.
sandbox: fresh /demo; export the accepted sample receipt and assert its schema, product, and decision

claim: Unlimited quotes cost $19 as a one-time purchase.
where: landing fact, data screen, paywall, terms
sandbox: fresh /demo; leave through Start for real, open Data and license, and assert the exact $19 one-time option

claim: The free edition supports up to five quotes.
sandbox: fresh /demo with two seeds; add three quotes and assert the fifth fills the free allowance

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: own fresh /demo browser context; install shell, set offline, reload, and assert both sample log and offline banner
